profile.headline: Gameplay Engineer Lead at Electronic Arts
profile.summary:
I built my first video game when I was 14 years old. Although I knew very little about programming, it didn’t stop me. Fast forward, I now have been the lead gameplay engineer for one of the most popular and influential games The Sims for over 13 years. 

My passion and focus are building the most engaging, delightful, fun and meaningful game experiences. I love new challenges, and I will leverage my experience and expertise to relentless pursue the best gameplay.

positions.locationName: Redwood City, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Lead Gameplay Engineer (Senior Software Engineer)
positions.description:
Lead a team of engineers to build and ship DLC titles in 5 years.
Design, review architectural and oversee software implementation with respect to performance, scope, and risk to deadlines.
Built and grew the gameplay engineering team through interviewing, recruiting, mentorship, performance evaluation and performance management.
Responsible for systems and features including: Posture Graph (decision making system in charge of evaluating how a sim animates and decides its next actions)

positions.title: Gameplay Engineer
positions.description:
Gameplay engineer for 5 Sims 3 expansion packs, Sims 3 Store, Sims 4 basegame and over 20 Sims 4 expansion packs
Developed multiple gameplay systems using Python, C# and C++.  All using the custom Sims 3 and Sims 4 engine
Key contributor to major releases, ensuring meeting deadlines, performance tuning and bug fixes.

positions.title: Game Engineer
positions.description:
Game Engineer Intern.

Worked in a team designing and programming multiple minigames for a currently unannounced project   
Developed minigames in Adobe Flash CS4 and the Box2D physics engine

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description: Communications and High Technology Analyst. Experience in implementation for a major Telecommunications Company in Bogota, Colombia. Worked in the Billing System Developing and Testing Team. Experience in requirement analysis, system configuration, user/client interaction and client support/training.

honors.title: Sims 4: Top 50 Games of All Time
honors.description: Sims 4 was awarded Time's The 50 Best Video Games of All Time list.
